notes.title: Alpha League Fully Released!
notes.content:
Elite warriors, to arms!

Beaver Entertainment is proud to announce our latest creation, "Alpha League," set to unfold its grand saga on the battlefields of The Primal Earth. This Hero-based Auto Chess game will officially launch on February 23, 2024, immersing you in a world on the brink of invasion by the "Singularity Legion."

In this uncertain conflict, humanity's finest elites rally within the Alpha League, sharing their secret techniques and bolstering their strengths, all to become the pivotal force in mankind's survival. "Alpha League" is more than just a game; it's a proving ground for heroes' wisdom and courage.

Game Features:
[list]
[*] Unique Combat Experience: Craft a one-of-a-kind battle style with your trained hero, combining skills from over 10 different genres.
[*] Diverse Battlefields: Prove you're the strongest warrior in a variety of challenging and stylistically distinct scenarios.
[/list]
Player Interaction and Community Participation:
[list]
[*] Discord: https://discord.com/invite/HBX3n2n4ND
[*] Email: support@beaveroid.com. We're here for you anytime you encounter an issue!
[/list]
The journey of "Alpha League" is about to begin, and we invite every player who loves strategy and challenges to join this adventure. Your feedback and support are driving us better. Let's rally under the banner of the Alpha League, together fighting off the Singularity Legion to protect The Primal Earth!

See you on February 23, 2024. Don't miss out!

Arm yourselves, warriors of the Alpha League!
— The Beaver Entertainment Team

notes.title: A letter from developer
notes.content:
Hello, esteemed members selected to join the Alpha League. I am Bluishrain, the Game Director, and I am thrilled to directly converse with all of you on behalf of the Beaveroid team. As you read this letter, we are just 21 days away from the official launch of “Alpha League”.

Our team is a small but passionate group of six, based in Hong Kong. We embarked on this journey during the pandemic, operating fully independently. Without investors or publishers, our R&D budget is entirely fueled by software outsourcing projects (a tad embarrassing, I confess). Despite our limited resources, we firmly believe that what we’ve created so far is intriguing and deserves to be shared with the public. I invite you to witness our vision: one year from now, “Alpha League” will undoubtedly be a game deserving of rave reviews.

The genesis of “Alpha League” stems from my experience with auto battlers, dating back to the early days of Dota Auto Chess. Whether it was Underlords or TFT, I’ve been an avid player. This genre is undeniably fun, but as a company employee, the frequent and substantial updates often left me bewildered. Taking a break meant falling behind. However, our team unanimously believes that beyond seasoned auto battlers, more players should be able to enjoy the thrill of this genre. Thus, we’ve crafted “Alpha League” to provide players with an incredible experience.

Now, let’s delve into the game itself. “Alpha League” unfolds its story in the year 2100, on the “Terra Prime” timeline. This world represents the pinnacle of human prosperity and power. Humanity has mastered cutting-edge technology and harnessed superpowers. Whether it’s deep-earth exploration or space colonization, nothing is beyond their reach. However, Terra Prime faces imminent invasion by the “Singularity Legion”. This formidable force originates from an artificial intelligence known as WeaponGPT, which emerged due to humanity’s insatiable greed, leading to unbridled AI development. To safeguard the last line of defense, factions that were once at odds—along with extraterrestrial allies—have pooled their closely guarded secrets. They’ve handpicked elite members to form the Alpha League, aiming to nurture humanity’s mightiest warriors and fend off the Singularity Legion.

In terms of gameplay, whether you’re a fan of auto battlers, roguelike enthusiasts, or simply someone who enjoys any multiplayer online strategy game, “Alpha League” caters to you. We won’t inundate you with verbose promotional text; instead, we invite you to experience the game firsthand. You’ll soon appreciate the joy of skill combinations, economic management, and character growth.

Thank you for taking the time to read my less-than-poetic ramblings.
We’ll see you on the training grounds.

Bluishrain, on behalf of the entire Beaveroid team.
Feb. 2nd, 2024

notes.title: 24/01/27 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Preface[/b]
For those of you who are interested in trying out Alpha League early. Our Playtest Server is now open to public. If you want to join, simply [b]apply for the Playtest[/b] on Store Page. 

We are expecting a server maintenance around Jan. 27th 10am CET/1am PST/5pm BJT. The maintenance will continue for about 1 hour. Like every week before, please [b]restart Steam[/b] to update the game client.

[b]Part. 1 Content[/b]
1. We have temporarily retired Marble, because we cannot fix his texture issue for the moment. We apologize to those who love Marble, and we expect Marble to be back soon.
2. A new hero - the North Berserker "Eyvar" is available for play now. Please check for details in Library. Eyvar is tanky and mainly deals damage by critical hits.

[b]Part. 2 Balance[/b]
1. Buff: the healing amount for Adrenaline (Heal Genre Legendary Skill) has been 33% increased.
2. Rework: talents (passive skill) of Jenny and Alicia are stronger now in early game (because we find new players may fail 1-7 monster round with these 2 heroes) and slightly weaker in late game.
3. Reworked mechanism of Credit card. You can always overdraft now.
4. Buffed damage of Damage Reflection (Shield+Curse Normal Skill), check out in library.
5. You can now pick identical heroes.

[b]Part. 3 Miscellaneous[/b]
1. Fixed reconnection issue. When players quit lobby or are disconnected for a long time, they should still be able to reconnect. Especially when play as a team.
2. Tweaked the Elo System. It will be easier for a good player to climb the ladder. However, when a player loses, he or she also loses more elo points.
3. Improved Bot intelligence. New players should be able to experience a smoother learning curve.
4. Improved UI in several places. We will keep improving the UI.
5. Keep improving performance on earlier specs computers.
6. Fixed sound effect bug for Opal.
7. Fixed all the known bugs.
8. Fixed some text mistakes.

[b]Expectation for next week[/b]
1. Allocate more currency resources (through Rank Rewards and so on) to players, so cultivating a few main heroes will be faster.
2. We will try to fix the Steamdeck compatibility issue.
3. Lobby UI upgrade (as surveyed earlier at Discord/Reddit).
4. We are planning about new heroes/genres/artifacts/maps before the official release, but this may taker longer than next week. Thank you for being patient with us. We hope you enjoy the time with Pals.

notes.title: Patch Notes (2024/01/19 Version 0.1.20)
notes.content:
[b]IMPORTANT – change of CBT rules[/b]
After eight days of conducting the CBT, we are thrilled to see that our players’ passion has far exceeded our expectations. Some of our players have already played for more than 100 hours. It feels like so much more than just a playtest to us. To show our appreciation for your support, we have decided that although we will still reset the rank elo by the end of the playtest, all playtest players can keep their hero levels, cosmetics, currencies, and hero shards when the official server is online. Nonetheless, all in-app purchase policies remain valid – we will still offer a 200% reward for any payment activities. Thanks again for your support.

[b]Part #1 – New Content[/b]
1.	Added 2 new maps (check in library) – 1. Hell Shrine; 2. Necro Earth Office
2.	Added 16 new artifacts (check in library) – 1. Balance Force; 2. Credit Card; 3. Gaze of the Elder; 4. Credit Loans; 5. Easter Egg; 6. Fencing Exercise; 7. Mind Exercise; 8. Pace Exercise; 9. Lifting Exercise; 10. Meditation Exercise; 11. Polar Exercise; 12. Alchemy Exercise; 13. Blocking Exercise; 14. Faith Exercise; 15. Warlock Exercise; 16. Book of Chance

[b]Part #2 – Balance[/b]
1.	Crit/Evasion triggered skills were slightly buffed.
2.	Added probability to all Heal/Shield/Curse triggered skills.
3.	Crystal Blade: probability +100%, damage -50%.
4.	Shuffling related artifacts were slightly buffed.
5.	-5 gold discount for “start spinning”.
6.	Nana’s Mystic Form duration +1s, Attack Speed and Attack Damage coefficients +1, and animation time is now faster
7.	Sylvie’s Windwalk cooldown -1s, Storm shot base damage +50.
8.	Marble’s Lifecut damage coefficient +4%.
9.	Moriatee is now stronger in early game and weaker in late game now, both ult and talent got tweaked (check in library).
10.	Shield/Heal Ultimate Duration -1s, trigger interval changed to 0.1s, total effect amounts unchanged.
11.	Profitable becomes a unique artifact.
12.	Night owl was slightly buffed.
13.	The damage reduction proportion for Talisman, Body Armor, Enhanced Vaccine +5%.
14.	Preparation phase timer +5 seconds.
15.	Bedivere’s ultimate animation is now faster

[b]Part #3 – Miscellaneous[/b]
1.	Added “Slow Mode” to Bot Match and Tutorial for comprehensive reading.
2.	Added tooltips for frost/poison/shield/curse buffs.
3.	When your ultimate is Disintegrated by Judie, your mana bar becomes black now.
4.	When you are immune to control, the frost stacks become red.
5.	Updated cloak texture for Jacquelyn.
6.	Changed Simplified Chinese Font.
7.	Changed UI color for Tutorial.
8.	Added CD-Key function which you can find in the “activities” button, which is a giftbox icon.
9.	Fixed all the detected bugs.
10.	Fixed some text and localization issues.
11.	Fixed some sound effect issues.
